effect.name: AI Noise Removal (DeepFilterNet)
effect.description: Deep-learning speech denoiser. Removes non-stationary background noise (cafe, street, crowd, keyboard, wind) while preserving the voice. Heavier than the RNNoise-based Noise Suppressor but much stronger on real-world location audio.
effect.author: Hendrik Schröter

parameter.name: Attenuation Limit (dB)
parameter.comment: How far detected noise is turned down. 100 = maximum removal; lower values leave more of the room tone in.
